name: Chicken Cacciatore
method: skillet / braise (browned then simmered in tomato-wine sauce, lid on)
ingredients_verbatim: 2 rosemary sprigs (~15 cm/6" long), or 1 tsp dried rosemary
3 anchovy fillets (or 1 tsp anchovy paste), optional
3/4 cup pinot noir or other dry red wine
Mashed potato or polenta (for serving, optional)
unmapped: kalamata olives (board has green-olives/black-olives, not kalamata specifically)
why: Classic Italian braise, not in catalog (only a slow-cooker cacciatore PASTA exists; this is the sauced braise, no pasta). Published RTE nutrition 495 cal / 37g protein / 15g carbs per serving sits mid-band on all three axes. Structurally low-carb (chicken thighs + tomato + peppers + mushrooms + olives, no starch base). Batch-scales cleanly in a braising pot with weigh-and-divide. Anchovy is optional and cooks away as a flavor base, not seafood-forward. Good pricer-lane test: red wine, rosemary, bay, kalamata are genuine board gaps to flag.
confidence: high - read nutrition directly from source page
